convert_deformable_detr_checkpoint: convert a Deformable DETR PyTorch checkpoint to HuggingFace transformers format with configurable options
rename_key: rename checkpoint keys from the original Deformable DETR naming convention to HuggingFace transformer naming
read_in_q_k_v: split concatenated query-key-value projection weights into separate q_proj, k_proj, and v_proj layers
prepare_img: download a sample COCO validation image for verifying the converted model output
convert_deformable_detr_cli: run the Deformable DETR checkpoint conversion script via argparse CLI with optional flags
